Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

school.epi.abm (development version)

  • R CMD check passes with no warnings. Package code refers to data columns through .data$ and to the day.name dataset by its full name, the help page for summarize_records() matches its code again, and the citation in run_simulation()’s help uses \doi{}.
  • Packages used only by the analysis scripts and the app launcher (conflicted, ggplot2, htmltools, knitr, lemon, pkgload, RColorBrewer, scales) move from Imports to Suggests, and the unused gridExtra is dropped. The Title is in title case. Seeded simulation results are unchanged.
  • Package code follows the lab style guide (https://morrison-lab.github.io/psc/): the native pipe |> replaces magrittr pipes (so the package now needs R >= 4.1.0 and no longer imports magrittr), <- replaces = for assignment, lines are wrapped at 80 characters, and commented-out code is removed.
  • A .lintr.R file applies the lab’s shared linters from the lms package. Seeded simulation results are unchanged.
  • Every exported function and the day.name dataset are documented, including all of run_simulation()’s arguments.
  • DESCRIPTION and citation("school.epi.abm") now cite the published paper (Morrison et al., 2023, https://doi.org/10.3389/fpubh.2023.856940) instead of the 2021 preprint.
  • DESCRIPTION lists the GitHub repository and issue tracker.
  • The package has its first tests: smoke tests for run_simulation(), summarize_records(), analyze_results() and plot1_plotly(), plus a snapshot of seeded results that fails if a change alters them.
  • The example data file and analysis script in inst/extdata are renamed without spaces: lac-covid-data-simple.xlsx and abm-results-loop.R.
  • The LA County incidence-rate report moves from vignettes/ to analyses/. It was a standalone report rather than a package vignette, and the package no longer declares a vignette builder.
  • Development setup (.Rprofile and the Copilot setup workflow) no longer loads the archived pryr package.

school.epi.abm 0.0.0.9002

  • Package code refers to data columns through the rlang data pronoun, to function arguments through its environment pronoun, and groups with .by, so R CMD check no longer reports undefined global variables for them. Seeded simulation results and summaries are identical to 0.0.0.9001.

school.epi.abm 0.0.0.9001

  • run_simulation() installs and runs again on current CRAN packages: it no longer depends on pryr (archived on CRAN) or the deprecated purrr::rbernoulli(), and works with dplyr 1.2, which made multi-row summarise() an error. The replacements make the same random draws in the same order as before.
  • plot1_plotly() now imports plotly::subplot().
  • summarize_records() keeps all-missing quantile columns numeric, so analyze_results() works on small simulations.
